landing.eyebrow: A 3D café to study and work in
landing.title:
A warm corner of the café
for your focus hours
landing.lead: Pick an empty table, open your laptop with Pomodoro, to-dos and your own playlist. People stroll by outside, others work quietly inside.
landing.note: Free · runs right in your desktop browser

focus.title: Pomodoro & to-dos
focus.text: A 25/5 timer, task list and notes right on your laptop.

music.title: Café radio & your playlist
music.text: The café TV plays lofi for everyone. Put on headphones to hear your own YouTube playlist.

together.title: Sit side by side
together.text: Work alongside others in the café. No chat, no camera.
